entity.description: Immutable trail of platform-admin mutations (admin.* services, migrations, super-admin data-source definitions, crypt-key rotation, retention runs), and since DAR-BE-267 of public GraphQL API key mints, rotations and disables (moqui-gql gql.GqlAuthServices, by a tenant admin or super admin). One row per mutation, written in the same transaction as the change itself (a migration run or a retention run, which own no transaction, write theirs once done). DAR-BE-265: create-only, so the entity facade refuses every update and delete (EntityValue.update/delete, updateAll, deleteAll, and the update#/delete#/store# entity-auto services); the database-level REVOKE of UPDATE and DELETE from the app user is the ops step in docs/reconciliation/platform/security.md ("Admin audit trail").

field.name: adminUserId
field.description: Operator who performed the mutation: a super admin, or a tenant admin for a GqlApiKey row.

field.name: serviceName
field.description: Full admin service name that performed the mutation.

field.name: targetType
field.description: Kind of record affected, e.g. Tenant, User, Membership, AgentAccessGrant, CliAccessGrant, CliAccessRequest, Migration, DataSourceDefinition, EncryptedFields, GeneratedOutputFiles, Retention, GqlApiKey.

field.name: targetId
field.description: Primary identifier of the affected record (tenant group id, user id, or composite).

entity.description: DAR-BE-265. One row per file a person downloads or exports from Darpan: who, which tenant, which file and format, how big, when. Never the file's contents. Create-only like AdminAuditLog: the app cannot change or remove a row.

field.name: companyUserGroupId
field.description: The active tenant the file was read for; blank only for a super admin's legacy screen download with no tenant selected.

field.name: resourceType
field.description: What was served: GENERATED_OUTPUT (a run result or a run's source file through get#GeneratedOutput) or LEGACY_DIFF_FILE (the super-admin screen download).

field.name: resourceRef
field.description: The file name or data-manager relative path that was asked for.

field.name: serviceName
field.description: The service or screen transition that served it.
